integrity: An unrestricted exact-integer divisibility argument classifies every \(a\ge1\) and odd prime \(p\). The verifier checks finitely many independent instances and does not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: No assertion is made for odd prime powers \(p^b\) with \(b\ge2\), composite odd cofactors, or infinitude of primes \(3\cdot2^a-1\). The original database already states the sufficient family; the theorem proves necessity.
title: Complete \(2^a p\) classification of the divisor-sum/totient congruence
